newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept tractor sales up 32.6 pct y/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept tractor sales up 32.6 pct y/yr.

text.p: China's sales of tractors with at least 20 horsepower jumped 32.6 percent in the first nine months of 1996 to 65,675 units compared with the year-ago period, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
State Statistical Bureau experts forecast annual demand for medium- and large-size tractors would exceed 80,000 units by the year 2000, the newspaper said.
A bureau survey showed that 8.59 percent of 10,000 rural families interviewed nationwide planned to buy tractors within the next three years, it said without giving further details.
